aboutGame.title: What is Trades Pets Universe?
paragraphs: Trades Pets Universe is a Roblox pet-collection game built by Lip Builds around a simple loop: collect coins, buy eggs, hatch pets, and trade the ones you do not need. With hundreds of unique pets and new updates every week, the goal is to build the strongest collection you can.

There is no developer-set price list, so the community decides what every pet is worth. Rarity sets a floor, while demand and supply decide the ceiling, which is why the players who read the market early are the ones who trade up. Our wiki covers pet values, hatching odds, trading safety, codes, and progression routes so you can grow your collection without getting burned.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Trades Pets Universe.

items.question: What is Trades Pets Universe?
items.answer: Trades Pets Universe is a Roblox pet-collection game by Lip Builds. You collect coins, buy eggs, hatch pets across several rarity tiers, and trade duplicates with other players to build a stronger collection.

items.question: How do I start in Trades Pets Universe?
items.answer: Follow the beginner loop: learn how coins are earned, hatch a batch of cheap eggs, lock your best pets in your inventory, then make one small trade to learn the trade window before risking anything valuable.

items.question: Are there working Trades Pets Universe codes?
items.answer: Yes. Codes such as update2 and 1mvisits have granted fruits, boosts, and potions, while codes like Russo and DarkRose award items such as a Banana, Kiwi, or Coins Potion. Redeem them in the game's code box before they expire.

items.question: How are pet values decided in Trades Pets Universe?
items.answer: There is no developer-set price list. Rarity sets a floor, but demand, supply, and how recently a pet was released decide the ceiling, which is why community value lists move after every update.

items.question: Is trading safe in Trades Pets Universe?
items.answer: Trades are final once both players confirm, so slow down at the confirmation screen, compare each pet, and set a minimum price before you negotiate. Never let a countdown pressure you into accepting.

items.question: How do you earn diamonds in Trades Pets Universe?
items.answer: Diamonds are the hard currency behind the Trades Pets Universe economy. Daily login rewards, quests and objectives, selling duplicate pets, and limited-time events are the main ways to earn them, and diamonds also work as trade filler when you need to balance an uneven offer.
